title: UMS process preview response
description: Written by ProcessPreviewAdapter (crates/ums-profile-sdk/src/preview.rs) only after the runner ran twice as separate processes with byte-identical stdout and the validator exited 0. A refused or failed preview produces no response document. Numbers are integers within +-(2^53-1).

replay.description: Both runner processes wrote identical bytes. A difference is refused as ReplayMismatch, so no other value exists.

documents.description: The runner's stdout, one JSON document per line, in order. The documents the explain lens reads are the runner output (the enaction-runner-output/1 envelope, which carries the world-truth atoms) and the enaction-mind-trace/1 document. Their full schemas belong to Enaction; only the members UMS reads are named here.

runnerOutput.description: enaction-runner-output/1: {package, world_truth: [atom], ledger_trace?}. UMS reads package.beliefs, package.events and world_truth.

mindTrace.description: enaction-mind-trace/1, as defined in enaction-engine docs/proposals/WEEVIL-HOST-ROUTE.adoc.
